input: Find half-day and morning-only summer camps for young kids (ages 3-6) for kids and teens in Henderson, Transylvania, Polk, Haywood and Jackson counties, NC (Hendersonville, Brevard, Tryon, Waynesville, Sylva). Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.
searches: Hendersonville preschool summer camp 2026 half day ages 3 5

candidates.name: Grace Lutheran Church of Hendersonville
candidates.note: Preschool summer camp runs Tuesday–Thursday, 8:30 a.m.–1 p.m., late May–August; limited to enrolled preschool children.

candidates.name: Hendersonville Presbyterian Church
candidates.note: Two-week July morning art program for ages 2–3 and 4–6, subject to enrollment; page does not specify the summer year.

candidates.name: Mountain Roots
candidates.note: Half-day preschool camp for ages 4–5, plus full-day camp and middle-school leadership opportunities; 2027 registration announced.

candidates.name: Tryon Fine Arts Center
candidates.note: 2026 SASY camp offered ages 5–7 mornings, 9 a.m.–noon, and older children full days; also runs summer theater camp.
